rows.name: Wonder Lab
covers: 2 Science & nature: animals/habitats, birds/insects/sea, solar system, weather, plants, human body, water cycle, environment
channels: PBS KIDS (Wild Kratts, Nature Cat playlists)
rows.notes: Animals now live here (the hidden Animals row is merged in). Peekaboo Kidz and PBS KIDS are Tier 2. Body topics go to H under R8.

rows.name: Number Fun
covers: 12 Brain development: puzzles, patterns, matching, sorting, reasoning, memory, spot the difference
channels: Smile and Learn - English (visual-attention, logic, patterns)
rows.notes: Brain games share this row; the warm-up (§5A) already gives puzzle practice every session. Smile and Learn is Tier 2: its titles often carry emoji, so R9 will drop some videos, and it posts Shorts (R1). Highlights Kids targets ages 6-12; its ID came from a mirror site (medium confidence), and every video goes to H.

rows.name: Story & Word Corner
covers: 1 Educational: ABC, phonics, simple words, days/months/seasons
7 Language & communication: English vocabulary, listening, pronunciation, picture vocabulary, Q&A
4 Rhymes & music (part): alphabet and vocabulary songs, single songs only
channels: Super Simple Songs (single learning songs only)
rows.notes: Super Simple Songs: only single songs of 5 min or less pass (R2/R10 drop the compilations). Dream English Kids' ID came from a mirror site (medium confidence) and it is Tier 2.

rows.name: Move & Sport
covers: 9 Physical activity: kids yoga, exercises, dance, indoor movement games, brain breaks, animal moves, balance
Sport skills (father's request): football, cricket, throw-catch, running
pending: UC id not found by search; resolve with channels.list
rows.notes: At least 20 sport_skill videos before the sport slot rule switches on (D20/D30). Movement songs count here, not as a separate rhymes row.

rows.name: Kind Hearts Stories
covers: 3 Moral stories & values: honesty, sharing, helping, respecting elders, friendship, kindness, problem-solving
8 Social & emotional: emotions, anger, fear, confidence, friends, turn-taking, teamwork, family
channels: Bluey (clips of 8 min or less, at most 10% of the row)
rows.notes: The hidden Feelings row is merged in, which gives social-emotional learning a real share.

rows.name: Healthy Me
covers: 6 Life skills & habits: brushing, handwashing, hygiene, healthy food, dressing, tidying, road safety, manners
channels: Sesame Street (healthy habits, Brushy Brush, handwashing)
Daniel Tiger - Scholastic (safety, potty, manners strategy songs)
Super Simple Songs (brush teeth, wash hands, clean up)
Sesame Workshop - India (Hindi; health and hygiene)
rows.notes: Gap: no verified Indian road-safety channel. Hand-pick 5 road-safety videos (H). Western road clips show right-hand traffic, so prefer Indian ones.

rows.name: Stories from India
covers: 11 Indian culture & awareness: festivals, national symbols, community helpers, monuments, transport, geography, folk tales, diversity
channels: infobells - Kannada (single concept songs of 5 min or less only)
Murty Media - Story Time with Sudha Amma (playlist)
rows.notes: Merges the live 'Hindi stories' and 'Stories from India' rows. Kannada and Hindi are a property of each video (D7a/D37), with the English fallback. Myth items go to H for the first 10 (demon or battle scenes; fearTone of 2 or less).

rows.name: Make & Draw
covers: 5 Creativity & arts: drawing, colouring, painting, paper craft, origami, clay, DIY toys, creative storytelling
pending: Crafty Carol / Easy Kids Craft / Mr. Schuette's Art Class
resolve UC ids; Common Sense Media lists them for ages 5-7
rows.notes: Recency check: only Art for Kids Hub is confirmed with recent long-form uploads (Nov 2026). Draw So Cute (Shorts-heavy risk) and Mister Maker (possibly back-catalogue only; ID came from a mirror site) need a Phase-0 feed check for at least 3 recent non-Short videos.

rows.name: Giggles
covers: 10 Entertainment & imagination: educational cartoons, puppets, fantasy, pretend play, animal adventures, riddles, gentle comedy
rows.notes: Laughter has value of its own. Every video still runs R2 (compilations).
